ALL YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

### How durable are Quince hard-shell suitcases?

Our suitcases have a lightweight, durable polycarbonate hard shell that's built to handle bumps in transit and time out in the elements. Like any polycarbonate luggage, the shell will pick up some scuffs and wear over time, especially if you check it. To clean it, wipe it down with a soft, damp cloth, warm water and a mild soap.
